name: Image-rights or endorsement income paid to a third-country entity instead of the athlete
description: Earnings from endorsement, image or commercial rights are directed to a company or account in a jurisdiction unconnected to the athlete or the paying party, with no clear contractual basis.
fp: Athletes legitimately use personal service companies and image-rights vehicles, often for tax planning. Concern arises when the vehicle's location, ownership or timing has no commercial explanation.

links.name: Image-rights or endorsement income paid to a third-country entity instead of the athlete
links.ctx: Image-rights fees for a player are paid to an offshore company owned by a nominee or an agent, not the player.
